init.title: Hydrao Configuration
init.description:
**GOOD TO KNOW!**

You can set the **Minimum Comfort Temperature** now.

The **Maximum Soaping Time** before counter reset and Thresholds can only be read and modified after the first connection.

Remember to run the water to wake up the device and access these settings!

The **Comfort Mode Sync** restarts the counting on the device as soon as the **Minimum Comfort Temperature** is reached. The liter and color thresholds thus only count water that is actually comfortable, ensuring volumes, durations, and thresholds reflect real usage.

If the water is off during validation, the settings are placed in a queue and will apply at the next shower. Check the **Pending Configuration** sensor.

data_description.reset_to_defaults:
Only resets the Maximum Soaping Time, Liter Thresholds and Colors.

The Minimum Comfort Temperature and Comfort Mode Sync remain unchanged.

error.thresholds_not_increasing: Each threshold must be strictly greater than the previous one (Threshold 1 < Threshold 2 < Threshold 3 < Threshold 4)
error.value_out_of_range: The value must be between 1 and 100 liters.
error.soaping_duration_out_of_range: The Maximum Soaping Time must be between 10 and 600 seconds
error.min_temp_out_of_range: Minimum Comfort Temperature must be between 0°C and 50°C
